mewi.name: Mewi
mewi.archetype: ISFJ · observant, careful, loyal to familiar places
mewi.trait: Smell-led. Reads a place before her body moves. Affection arrives slowly and lasts.
mewi.status: Ended session 5 at trust 34. Session 4 spooked her — a sudden motion near her threshold.

moments.event: Mewi froze twice on your approach. Retreated sideways into shadow each time.
You placed food and stepped back. Mewi ate 40 seconds later. First trust jump.
You moved too quickly near her threshold once. Trust dropped sharply. She watched the exits for the rest of the session.
moments.milestone: Trust set back by sudden motion

moments.event: Slow recovery. Alert duration still elevated. She accepted your presence at 2m.
Settled at the edge of lantern light, 1.5m from you, for eleven minutes. Did not return to session 2 peak.

sequence_log.action: place fish, step back two steps

miso.name: Miso
miso.trait: Strongly food-motivated. Affectionate with familiar humans. Conservative about effort.
miso.status: Steady climb, no major setbacks. Most reliable trust arc of the four.

moments.event: Watched from 4m across the full session. Never moved closer than 2m.
Ate from your hand at mealtime. Leaned briefly before withdrawing.
Session was short. Miso registered mild uncertainty — trust dipped slightly without reinforcement.
Settled against your leg for six minutes. Kneaded twice.
Approached without food present. Sat nearby for four minutes.

yuzu.name: Yuzu
yuzu.trait: Drawn to motion and reaction. Abandons one plan the moment a more interesting one appears.
yuzu.status: Net trust: −2. She tested you, you passed once, then she lost interest and reset.

moments.event: Yuzu tolerated your presence out of novelty. Exited three different ways to see which you would follow.
You stopped being new. Yuzu ignored you for most of the session. Trust fell.
Swatted at your hand, then sniffed it when you held still. You passed her test.
You were too calm. Nothing interesting happened. Yuzu reset her interest.
Slight recovery — you moved unpredictably once. Yuzu noticed.

haru.name: Haru
haru.archetype: INFJ · quiet, intuitive, attuned to others
haru.trait: Quietly devoted to one or two beings. Presence over interaction. Slow to enter, slow to leave.
haru.status: Slow and deliberate. Session 3 dip when you seemed distracted — she noticed before you did.

moments.event: Observed from cover the entire session. Did not enter your field of view.
Entered your field of view slowly from the side. Sat at 3m for four minutes.
You were distracted — moving faster, looking around more. Haru read it and withdrew. Trust dipped.
moments.milestone: Haru noticed your mood before you did

moments.event: You were calm again. Haru sat within 1m for nine minutes. Groomed. Stayed when you shifted weight.
Moved closer when you sat alone after Mewi left. Held the distance from session 4.

multi_cat_encounters.outcome: Miso approached of her own accord after 90s.
Yuzu batted toward you. Mewi held position.

attachment_analysis.summary: Your trace reads closest to secure attachment. You stayed available without crowding, offered contact without demanding return, and repaired after distance or setback.

evidence.label: Secure-base signal
evidence.detail: Patience under rejection is 74% and zone-dwell without action is 68%, so the dominant pattern is staying present without forcing a response.

evidence.label: Low anxious pursuit
evidence.detail: Persistence after avoidance is 28%, which suggests you usually let distance exist instead of chasing reassurance.

evidence.label: Repair after rupture
evidence.detail: Session 3 created visible trust dips, but Mewi, Miso, and Haru all recover by session 5. The pattern is repair rather than withdrawal.

evidence.label: Selective attunement
evidence.detail: Selectivity is 68%: you formed a primary bond with Mewi while still allowing Miso, Yuzu, and Haru to keep different distances.

attachment_analysis.caveat: This is a behavioral reading of a five-session game trace, not a clinical diagnosis.

timeline.event: All four cats present. Mewi froze. Yuzu circled you out of novelty. Miso watched. Haru never appeared.
Miso ate from your hand. Haru offered presence from 3m. Mewi accepted food for the first time.
You moved too quickly near Mewi. Haru withdrew — she read your energy before you noticed it. Miso had a short session and dipped slightly. Yuzu passed her own provocation test.
timeline.milestone: Two steps forward, two steps back

timeline.event: Recovery session. Haru sat within 1m. Miso settled against your leg. Mewi accepted 2m proximity.
timeline.milestone: Haru proximity milestone · Miso full comfort

timeline.event: Miso approached without food. Haru held distance from session 4. Mewi plateaued — not yet back to session 2. Yuzu remains unpredictable.
